name: Love Letter
edition: 2019 Z-Man Games rulebook, 21-card edition with Spy and Chancellor

source.title: Love Letter rules of play (2019), copy

setup.text: Shuffle the 21 character cards into a facedown deck.
Set the top card aside facedown without looking.
Also set 3 more cards aside faceup.
Take a reference card. Return any extras to the box.
Deal one card from the deck to each player as their hand.
Whoever most recently hand-wrote a letter goes first.

turn.summary: Draw a card, then play one of your two cards and do what it says. Play goes clockwise.
steps: Draw the top card of the deck.
Choose one of your two cards and play it faceup in front of you, resolving its effect. Keep the other.
Guard (1): name a card other than Guard; if another player holds it, they are out.
Priest (2): secretly look at another player's hand.
Baron (3): compare hands secretly with another player; the lower card is out.
Handmaid (4): other players cannot choose you until your next turn.
Prince (5): a player of your choice, even you, discards their hand and draws a new one.
Chancellor (6): draw 2, keep 1 of your 3, and put the other 2 facedown under the deck in any order.
King (7): swap hands with another player.
Countess (8): no effect, but you must play it if the other card is the King or a Prince.
Princess (9): if you play or discard it, you are out.
Spy (0): no effect, but see scoring.

round_end: The round ends when the deck is empty after a turn, or when only one player remains.
If the deck ran out, remaining players reveal hands. Highest value wins, and tied players all win.
The round winner takes a favor token. A sole survivor wins at once.
Reshuffle and repeat steps 2 to 4 of setup. The last round's winner goes first; if tied, choose randomly among them.
end: The game ends when a player holds enough favor tokens for the number of players. More than one player can win together.

scoring.text: The winner of each round takes 1 favor token.
Spy: if you are the only player still in the round who played or discarded a Spy, take 1 extra token. Two Spies still give only 1.
The Spy token does not count as winning the round.

tiebreak: The rulebook allows several players to win at the same time.

missed.text: When knocked out, discard your hand faceup without using its effect. You are skipped until the next round and cannot be chosen.
The Countess rule applies only to the card you hold on your turn, not to cards drawn for other effects such as the Chancellor.
Do not show your other card when you play the Countess, so others cannot tell if you were forced.
If every other player is protected by a Handmaid, Guard, Priest, Baron or King play has no effect, but a Prince must target yourself.
If the deck is empty when the Prince hits a player, they draw the facedown set-aside card.
If a player is forced to discard the Princess to your Prince, they are out of the round.
A Baron tie knocks out neither player.

not_covered: The classic-version variant (without Guard, Chancellors and Spies, 2 to 4 players) is not covered.
